rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "I'm excited to introduce Halcyon Threshold—a new initiative dedicated to ensuring the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. We're at a critical juncture. AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, likely reaching human-level AGI within years. While safety research is progressing, it substantially lags behind capabilities development. Halcyon Threshold provides: • Comprehensive educational resources on AI alignment and safety • Continuous monitoring of AI developments and safety progress • Practical frameworks for responsible AI development • Research synthesis connecting technical, governance, and policy work All resources are open and free. Whether you're a researcher, developer, policymaker, or simply someone who cares about ensuring good AI outcomes, there's something for you. This isn't about fear—it's about ensuring the flourishing future we all want. Superintelligent AI could be the best thing that ever happened to humanity. Let's make sure it is. Visit: halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app We stand at the threshold. Let us ensure the future ahead is halcyon. #AISafety #AIAlignment #ResponsibleAI #FutureOfAI"
